set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit [parameter2] family inet address [p.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set routing-options static route [parame.explanation: This command configures a static route in Junos, where `[parameter1]` is the destination network and `[parameter2]` is the subnet mask.

next-hop [parameter3].explanation: Configure the static route, specify the next jump address.

set forwarding-options hash-key family [.explanation: This Junos command fragment configures the hash key parameters for load balancing in a specific address family (e.g., IPv4, IPv6) by specifying `[parameter1]` as the key component.

parameters.name: family
parameters.explanation: The protocol community, e.g., is indicated by the name of IPv4.

set protocols bfd interface [parameter1].explanation: Enables the BFD protocol on the specified interface.

minimum-interval [parameter2].explanation: Configures the minimum dispatch interval for BFD protocols.

minimum-receive-interval [parameter2].explanation: Configures the minimum time for receiving BFD protocols.

parameters.name: minimum-receive-interval
parameters.explanation: The minimum receiving interval in milliseconds.

multiplier [parameter2].explanation: Configure the detection multiples of BFD protocols.

parameters.name: multiplier
parameters.explanation: Multiplier for testing to calculate the time of the detection.

set protocols bfd peer [parameter1].explanation: This command configures BFD (Bidirectional Forwarding Detection) for a specific peer, enabling fast detection of network failures between two endpoints.

parameters.name: peer-address
parameters.explanation: IP address of the BFD equivalent.

interface [parameter2] local-address [pa.explanation: Configure pager information for BFD protocols, including pager addresses, interfaces and local addresses.
